name: SEE Turtles Billion Baby Turtles Nesting Beach Grants
summary: Small grants for sea turtle organisations in the Global South, mostly to pay local people to patrol nesting beaches and protect nests. Three funds (general, new initiative, emergency) were all closed when read.

geography.label: Global South (US, Europe, Japan and Australia not eligible, their territories are)

amount.note: Per season; most grants are $2,000 to $5,000

status.quote: We are not currently accepting proposals for our general fund.

Berman New Initiative Fund: A partnership with the Berman Memorial Fund to support early stage turtle nesting beaches in developing countries. Grants are up to US $10,000 per year for three years. This fund is currently closed.
This grant is currently closed but contact us here if you have an urgent need.

applicant_types.quote: Billion Baby Turtles supports sea turtle conservation organizations that work to protect sea turtle hatchlings around the world.

geography.quote: Grants are only available in the Global South (US, Europe, Japan, & Australia are not eligible though territories of these countries are eligible.)

access.quote: This fund is currently closed, but you are welcome to contact us here and share information about your project for future consideration.

amount.quote: Grant requests are up to US $10,000 per season but please note that most grants are between $2,000 - $5,000.
